summary: NaN's launch page for Success, an 18-style Art-Nouveau-goo titling family (Titling widths, Sans weights, Text), in toxic neon green, hot pink and near-black. Spaced-out chapter titles (C O N C E P T, S T O R Y, T E S T E R, F A M I L Y) separate a giant lettered hero, a first-person essay, two grids of specimen-poster pages, a Fontsampler.js variable line and six per-row testers, a style list framed by animated text-on-a-path, an in-use carousel and links to NaN's other microsites.

instances.ux: Nothing to do but scroll; nav and 'Download Trials' pill are fixed (the stitched capture repeats the bar mid-crop)
instances.learn: Turn the family name into a two-word slogan and let it overflow the viewport: the cropped letters show the wiggly details at a scale no specimen line would reach

instances.look: One huge magenta word 'VARIABLE' centred on pink; below, a thin control row: style dropdown left, one axis slider centre labelled 'Weight 983' (or 'Width 998'), Alternates and Ligatures outline buttons right, and round play/pause buttons under the slider
instances.ux: Type over the word; pick any of the 18 styles; the slider drives wdth (Titling, 100–1000) or wght (Sans/Text, 100–1100) depending on the style; Play animates the axis back and forth; Alternates/Ligatures toggle OpenType features
instances.learn: Give a variable tester a Play button: the axis sweep becomes an animation the visitor can stop at any point
